events.title: Mid-cycle breadth washout — the dip that got bought
events.detail: Only 2% of stocks above their 20-dma — an oversold flush inside the uptrend. The dip was bought and the advance resumed: bull-market behavior, and the template FOMO buyers extrapolated into 2026.

events.title: Composite peak — the structural top
events.detail: Equal-weight composite tops at 375 (+275% in 10 months), inside RenMac's 3–6-month topping window after the April bubble signal fired.

events.title: First crack — parabolic trend broken
events.detail: Sudden -9% drop in a week, taking the composite -17% off the peak. RenMac's 'shot across the bow' — structural momentum is damaged.

events.title: Failed retest — the lower high
events.detail: Oversold bounce recovers to 371, stalling 1.0% below the May high before rolling over. The right side of the topping pattern begins: good news (Samsung blowout, hyperscaler capex) no longer lifts prices.

events.title: 50-dma breakdown
events.detail: First close below the 50-day moving average since the peak — trend support gives way and trapped overhead supply starts capping every rally.

events.title: Post-peak breadth washout
events.detail: Breadth hits 2% above the 20-dma. Unlike November's washout, these oversold readings are producing bounces that fail — distribution, not accumulation.

events.title: Climax of the unwind
events.detail: Worst 5-day drop of the period: -22.4% in a week as the momentum trade liquidates. Breadth collapses into RenMac's 2–15% oversold zone.

events.title: Closing at the lows
events.detail: Composite ends the period at 216, -43% off the peak — no support level has held yet, and new-low expansion says distribution continues beneath the surface.

pillars.name: 1 · Bubble signal
pillars.headline: 34 of 64 stocks doubled in 12 months
pillars.detail: RenMac's rule is a double within TWO years; 34 names (53% of the full-history universe) cleared it in just one — a stricter screen than the rule itself.

pillars.name: 2 · Topping structure
pillars.headline: Peak → crack → lower high → new lows: full sequence present
pillars.detail: Peak 2026-05-26 → first crack (-17% by 2026-06-10) → failed retest 1.0% under the high (2026-06-15) → -22% climax week (2026-07-29) → now -20% off the peak. The multi-phase unwind RenMac describes is fully in place through the failed right shoulder.

pillars.name: 3 · Momentum unwind
pillars.headline: 65-day ROC -2% (was +114% at the extreme)
pillars.detail: Composite 65d ROC has swung 116 pts off its high. The top-minus-bottom momentum-quintile spread hit 239 pts on 2026-06-30 and has collapsed to 60 pts — high-momentum leaders are unwinding fastest (RenMac flagged an 84% momentum-spread extreme before the break).

pillars.name: 4 · Breadth & new lows
pillars.headline: 77% above 20-dma · 0 stocks at 3-mo lows
pillars.detail: Breadth sits inside the 2–15% oversold zone while 0 of 66 names close at 3-month lows — new-low expansion during weakness is the distribution signature RenMac watches. (True 52-wk lows are unmeasurable with 1 year of data; most stocks bottomed at the window start.)

pillars.name: 5 · Sentiment / flows
pillars.headline: Fund-flow sentiment still qualitative — up/down volume 0.88 is the closest proxy
pillars.detail: RenMac: SMH inflows in the 90th percentile despite drawdowns; Samsung blowout earnings and hyperscaler capex failed to lift prices — that flow/sentiment claim itself is still unverifiable from this file. What volume now adds is a partial proxy: the universe-wide up/down volume ratio and 8 distribution vs 3 accumulation days (25d) — see the Volume section below.
